title: Read a nested object property safely
summary: Retrieve a nested value from JSON data using a dot-separated path.
requirements: data is a JSON-compatible value and path is a string.
A nonempty path contains dot-separated property names; numeric path segments index arrays.
Return fallback when a property does not exist or traversal reaches null or a primitive before the path ends.
An existing property with value null is returned as null, not replaced by fallback.
For an empty path, return data unchanged.
Only access own properties (not inherited properties).
hints: Split a nonempty path on dots and visit one segment at a time.
Before each lookup, check that the current value is an object or array.
Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call distinguishes an absent key from a present null.
